clue.text: Be quiet in particular after defeat by editor

indicators.note: 'after' places the word before it at the end, following the defeat and the editor

parts.note: to pip someone is to beat them narrowly
one's own room is one's particular room

explanation.surface: An instruction about keeping silent after an editor has inflicted a defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'particular' means one's own, as in 'my own room'; to be pipped is British for being narrowly beaten.
explanation.definitionFit: To pipe down is an informal phrasal verb meaning to stop talking or make less noise.

clue.text: Royal measure endlessly covered by journalists

indicators.note: without its end, the measuring word loses its final letter
something covered by another sits inside it, so the journalists wrap round the measure

parts.note: the press is the body of journalists
INCH, a measure of length, with its last letter dropped

explanation.surface: A royal measure has been reported on, endlessly, by the press pack.
explanation.definitionFit: A princess is a female member of a royal family, so a royal in the noun sense.

clue.text: Lengthen article about university city

parts.note: to pad an essay is to lengthen it

indicators.note: 'about' here means turned around, so the article and university letters run the other way

explanation.surface: Extending an article about a city famed for its university.
explanation.walkthrough: Padua really is a historic university city, which makes 'university' look like part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Padua is a city in north-east Italy, home to one of Europe's oldest universities.

clue.text: Silence in broadcast that's costly, holding start of important commercial up

indicators.note: the costly word holds the other pieces inside itself
in a down entry, going up means reading from bottom to top
the start of a word is its opening letter only

explanation.surface: Silence on air is expensive when an important advert is held up.
explanation.definitionFit: Dead air is the broadcasting term for an unintended gap with no sound transmitted.

clue.text: Film star's joyful shout over one element with appeal about right

indicators.note: 'about' means surrounding, so the appeal goes round the right
in a down entry, 'over' puts the shout above what follows

parts.note: a whoop is a cry of joy

explanation.surface: A film star's happy cry, with talk of an element that has appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition includes the possessive: 'Film star's' reads as 'Film star is', the answer followed by the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoopi Goldberg is the American actress who won an Oscar for the film Ghost.

clue.text: Lawyer not lasting long

definitions.meaning: first meaning: informal term for a barrister or solicitor

explanation.surface: A lawyer who does not stay in a job very long.
explanation.walkthrough: A brief is also the case papers given to a barrister, and by extension the lawyer themself, mainly in British and Australian slang.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is slang for a legal representative, and the adjective means short-lived or of little duration.

clue.text: Child at home among tall grass, mostly

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the last letter goes
something among another is placed inside it

parts.note: BAMBOO, a tall grass, without its last letter
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A child playing at home among the tall grass of the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Bambino is the Italian word for a baby or young child, used informally in English.

clue.text: Part of Mediterranean island? One's in a developed area

indicators.note: something developed has been worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether part of the Mediterranean is an island in a built-up area.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark after 'island' tempts you to name a Greek island; it is just I.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ionian Sea is the arm of the Mediterranean lying between southern Italy and western Greece.

clue.text: Lot keeping south and north secure

indicators.note: the lot word keeps the south letter held inside it

parts.note: one's lot in life is one's fate
compass abbreviation, added at the end

explanation.surface: Plenty of measures to keep the south and north safe.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten something is to fix or make it secure, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Being sold rum, three men had made merry

indicators.note: merry means tipsy, and drunken words lurch out of their proper order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Three men sold rum and got merry on their own stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made merry' looks like a party but signals the rearrangement; merry is British for slightly drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods under the hammer are up for auction, where the auctioneer's gavel marks each sale.

clue.text: Popular face, not having left country

indicators.note: 'left' stands for its abbreviation, and 'not having' says that letter is removed

parts.note: a clock face is its dial

explanation.surface: A well-loved face that never left its homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: India is the large South Asian nation, the world's most populous country.

clue.text: Variety of smart neon decorations

indicators.note: a variety is a different version, so these letters come in a different arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A range of stylish neon lights hung up for the festive season.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornaments are decorative objects, such as baubles hung on a tree or trinkets on a shelf.

clue.text: Bend back with bundle containing very soft fruit

indicators.note: going back means reading the bend word from right to left

parts.note: an arc is a bend or curve

indicators.note: the bundle word contains the musical marking within it

parts.note: a bale is a bundle of hay or cloth
pianissimo, the musical marking for very soft

explanation.surface: Bending back to pick up a bundle of very soft, overripe fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The crab apple is a small, sour wild apple, the fruit of the Malus tree.

clue.text: Furious buccaneer deprived of power

indicators.note: deprived of means having something taken away, so a letter is removed

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A buccaneer is livid after losing his grip on power.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is an adjective meaning extremely angry, a near synonym for livid or enraged.

clue.text: Large shock received by spy ring, our team being superior

indicators.note: what is received by something is taken inside it

explanation.surface: A spy ring gets a big shock while our side gets the upper hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spy ring' looks like one unit; spy and ring are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone self-righteous acts morally superior, convinced of their own virtue and looking down on others.

clue.text: Gather in secret without initial despair

indicators.note: without its initial means the secret word loses its first letter
the gathering word goes inside the secret word

parts.note: CLOSET, as in a closet fan, minus its first letter
to gather news is to hear it

explanation.surface: Meeting secretly with no first move, then giving up hope.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose heart is an idiom meaning to become discouraged and give up hope.

clue.text: Guardian's purpose restricted by delay

indicators.note: something restricted by another is hemmed in by it

parts.note: an end is an aim or purpose

explanation.surface: A guardian's aim is held back by a delay.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition includes the possessive: 'Guardian's' reads as 'Guardian is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A defender protects or guards something, so is a guardian in the general sense.

clue.text: Breaking old rule, bashed bone

indicators.note: breaking something smashes it apart, so these letters are reassembled differently

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone flouting an old rule got bashed and broke a bone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bashed' looks like a second signal for rearranging, but it is part of the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The shoulder blade, or scapula, is the flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder.

clue.text: Shellfish? Yes, sort at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused and all over the place, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether shellfish are the kind found at sea, and agreeing.
explanation.definitionFit: Oysters are bivalve molluscs, a kind of edible marine shellfish prized for pearls.

clue.text: Good name retained by worker, for instance, qualified

indicators.note: something retained by another is held within it

parts.note: a worker is one kind of bee

explanation.surface: A good name kept by a qualified worker, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worker, for instance' gives BEE: a worker is an example of a bee, so 'for instance' belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Good as a noun, as in 'for the good of all', means advantage or benefit.

clue.text: Not so much raised to support very English craft

indicators.note: in a down entry, a supporting piece sits underneath the others
in a down entry, raised means read upwards, from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Less money was raised to support a very English boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel is a ship or boat, and craft is a general word for any boat.

clue.text: Distinctive character in sweet hospitality

indicators.note: 'in' says the letters sit within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A place known for its distinctive character in the form of warm welcomes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethos is the characteristic spirit or guiding beliefs of a community or organisation.

clue.text: Idea getting support with weight in one section of church

indicators.note: the weight goes inside the church section

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
the nave is the main body of a church

explanation.surface: An idea that wins support and carries weight in part of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the weight to its position: W goes in NAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainwave is a sudden clever idea or inspiration that comes to mind unexpectedly.

clue.text: Pawn in duel regularly set aside

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: second, fourth, sixth, eighth and tenth letters

explanation.surface: A pawn regularly sacrificed in a chess duel.
explanation.definitionFit: To annul is to declare invalid, as a court sets aside a marriage or judgment.

clue.text: Caught spirit with percussion instrument

explanation.surface: Caught out with a bottle of spirits alongside a drum kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A snare drum is a small drum with rattling wires across its lower skin, used in bands.

clue.text: Reported discovery, penalised

indicators.note: something reported is spoken out, so we need a word that sounds like the next one

explanation.surface: A reported discovery led to someone being punished.
explanation.definitionFit: To be fined is to be punished with a monetary charge, so penalised in a specific way.

clue.text: Aquatic plant from America added to collection

indicators.note: added to puts one piece on the end of the other

parts.note: a lot is a collection, as at auction

explanation.surface: A water plant from America has been added to a botanical collection.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a water lily-like plant growing in ponds, sacred in several Asian religions.

clue.text: Talkative type, upset, disrupting public relations

indicators.note: to disrupt something is to break into it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to rattle someone is to upset them

explanation.surface: A chatty, flustered person causing chaos in the PR office.
explanation.definitionFit: A prattler is someone who chatters at length about trivial things, a chatterbox.
